base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a glittering turquoise ocean offshore from the lighthouse, with soft rings of Wi-Fi light rippling across the waves. Lighting: dreamy twilight, glowing reflections.
In the shot: a pod of sleek, friendly grey dolphins with contented dreamy smiles.
Camera: Medium wide at water level, slow tracking.
Action: Three leagues offshore, dolphins drift asleep at the surface; glowing Wi-Fi rings from the distant lighthouse ripple over them and tiny dreamy nature-documentary images flicker in bubbles above their heads. One dolphin smiles contentedly in its sleep.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: gentle waves, sleepy dolphin clicks, soft digital shimmer, ambience of gentle waves, dolphin clicks, a soft digital shimmer.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
